set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/help-site.py >/dev/null <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
from __future__ import print_function

import os
import socketserver
from http.server import HTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler

ROOT = '/srv/legacy2/permanent-url-migration'


class HelpHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = 'HelpSite/1.0'

    def _redirect_manual(self):
        raw_path, separator, query = self.path.partition('?')
        if raw_path == '/manual' or raw_path.startswith('/manual/'):
            location = '/help' + raw_path[len('/manual'):]
            if separator:
                location += '?' + query
            self.send_response(301)
            self.send_header('Location', location)
            self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
            self.end_headers()
            return True
        return False

    def do_GET(self):
        if not self._redirect_manual():
            SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.do_GET(self)

    def do_HEAD(self):
        if not self._redirect_manual():
            SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.do_HEAD(self)


class ThreadingHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True


if __name__ == '__main__':
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8080), HelpHandler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/help-site.py
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/help-site.service >/dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Static help site with permanent legacy URL redirects
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=nobody
Group=nogroup
WorkingDirectory=/srv/legacy2/permanent-url-migration
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/sbin/help-site.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable help-site.service
sudo systemctl start help-site.service

systemctl is-enabled help-site.service
